lessons.title: Avoid using non-constexpr global variables in kernels
lessons.summary: Global variables used in Triton kernels must be constexpr to avoid compilation errors.
lessons.lesson: Ensure all global variables accessed within Triton kernels are declared as constexpr to avoid compilation errors.

lessons.title: Define Kernel Launch Parameters Explicitly
lessons.summary: Ensure all parameters used in Triton kernel launches are defined before they are referenced.
lessons.lesson: Define all variables used in the kernel launch configuration, such as num_warps, num_stages, and block sizes, before they are used in the kernel invocation.

lessons.title: Use Constexpr for Block Sizes
lessons.summary: Use constexpr for block sizes and other compile-time constants in Triton kernels to avoid runtime errors.
lessons.lesson: Declare block sizes and other compile-time constants using constexpr to ensure they are available at compile time during kernel compilation.
